alignments.note: The attributive demonstrative ταύταις occupies the English determiner slot, so the article realizes nothing (rule 38).
*up* realizes the preverb ἀνα- inside the participle's own unit (rule 106); the supplied juncture *and* goes to the finite verb it introduces (rule 88).
Anarthrous substantival adjective takes the supplied determiner itself (rule 58).
Article takes *the* with the case preposition riding along, headed on *the* (rules 17 and 21). Variant SBLGNT.ACT.1.15.v013 selects r00-base.
The juncture converting the participial clause into coordination is a rule 7 helper on the finite verb it introduces (rules 29 and 88).
The verb is expressed; the expletive *there* is a supplied subject riding with it (rule 9).
τε with no answering καί keeps the connective the ASV writes for it (rule 70).
Anarthrous noun with a supplied indefinite determiner as its helper (rule 51).
Genitive rendered *of persons*; the case preposition rides with the noun, no determiner standing on an article (rule 21).

ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό is rendered by the single word *together*, which answers to neither token separately (rule 45), exactly as rule 106 records for MAT.22.34, ACT.4.26 and ACT.2.44; head on the governed word.
A noncompositional unit never absorbs the intervening article, which contributes no part of the fused English word (rule 93).

The ASV's italicized *gathered* answers to no source token: the Greek clause has only ἦν and the phrase ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό, whose whole English is *together* (rule 5). Folding it into that phrase's unit remains defensible, but ACT.2.44 reads the bare phrase as *together* alone.
Approximative ὡς rendered *about*. Variant SBLGNT.ACT.1.15.v014 is underdetermined and its fallback carries the particle the English translates.
Supplied determiner inside the numeral phrase (rule 7).
The compound numeral's juncture *and* is a helper on the numeral it introduces (rule 29).

review_notes: *gathered* is marked added under rule 5, the whole English of ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό being *together*; the competing fold is named in that unit's note.
The article inside the noncompositional prepositional phrase is unrepresented under rule 93.
